app.title: AWS CCP Practice Exam
app.description: Practice for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) exam with real questions

home.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
home.subtitle: Practice Exam Platform
home.description: Simulate the real CLF-C02 exam with timed practice sessions. Questions are sourced from a curated practice bank.
home.studyModeDescription: The timer pauses when the tab is hidden. Feedback and explanations remain available.
home.simulationModeDescription: The timer continues while hidden. Browser visibility and focus signals are recorded as session incidents.

customExam.title: Custom exam
customExam.description: Choose your own time limit, question count, mode, and domain distribution.
customExam.previewIntro: Quotas use deterministic largest-remainder rounding and always total the requested question count.
customExam.question: question
customExam.studyModeDescription: The timer pauses when the tab is hidden.
customExam.simulationModeDescription: The timer continues while hidden and records browser signals.
customExam.durationRange: Enter a duration from 1 to 180 minutes.
customExam.percentageRange: Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100.
customExam.percentageSum: Domain percentages must add up to exactly 100%.
customExam.modeInvalid: Choose Study mode or Simulation mode.
customExam.invalidLink: This custom exam configuration is invalid. Return home and create it again.

home.disclaimer: This is a practice tool and does NOT represent official AWS exam results.

session.title: Practice Exam
session.question: Question
session.confirmSubmit: Are you sure you want to submit? Unanswered questions will be scored as incorrect.
session.timerRunningHidden: Timer continues while tab is hidden
session.missingSession: No active session found. Start a new practice exam.
session.integrityWarning: A tab visibility or focus change was recorded. This is a session signal, not proof of cheating or plagiarism. The simulation timer continued.
session.invalidCustomConfig: This custom exam configuration is invalid. Return home and create it again.
session.selectionTransition: Answer selected. Moving to the next question.
session.englishFallback: English source text is shown because a reviewed Spanish translation is not available for this question.
session.disclaimer: This score is an approximation and does NOT represent official AWS exam results. The AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam requires a scaled score of 700/1000.

results.title: Your Results
results.integrityIncidentNone: No browser visibility or focus incidents were recorded.
results.integrityIncidentNote: These are browser signals only, not proof of cheating or plagiarism.
results.reviewIntro: Expand any question to compare your answer, the correct answer, and the explanation.
results.nextStepPass: Review the questions you missed, then try a longer session to test retention.
results.nextStepFail: Study the priority domain below, review each missed answer, and retake a short session.
results.notAvailable: Explanation not available in this practice set.
results.weakAreaIntro: Complete a practice session to see your weak-area analysis.
results.disclaimer: This score is an approximation and does NOT represent official AWS exam results. The AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam requires a scaled score of 700/1000.
